defect.evidence_quote: where reason for crediting the source of the information is given
defect.problem: The holding is directionally supported but overbroad in its final clause. Ventresca does not hold that detailed underlying circumstances alone always establish probable cause; it adds source-crediting and magistrate-finding conditions and holds that this affidavit showed ample facts.
defect.proposed_fix: Revise to: Search-warrant affidavits are read commonsensically and realistically, not hypertechnically; hearsay may support a warrant when there is a substantial basis for crediting it; and where circumstances and source-crediting reasons are detailed and a magistrate has found probable cause, doubtful or marginal cases are resolved largely in favor of the warrant.

reasons: The commonsense/not-hypertechnical rule is directly supported by the opinion text.
The warrant-preference and doubtful-or-marginal formulation is supported, though the opinion uses a more qualified formulation.
The particular-affidavit holding is supported, but the payload states the affidavit rule at a broader categorical level than the opinion justifies.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use conditional phrasing such as "may establish" or include the source-crediting and magistrate-finding requirements.

residual_risks: No separate home-page taxonomy was disclosed; this stands only as a topic-fit/support judgment.
